summary: Kimi Antonelli won the Italian Grand Prix from P19 on the grid, 3.9s ahead of George Russell, with Max Verstappen completing the podium.
Kimi Antonelli made the biggest climb, from P19 to P1.
Pierre Gasly had a day to forget, dropping from P1 to P7.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag, 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised PER (5 second time penalty).
There were 30 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 66 points over George Russell.
